name: Phenytoin
summary: Phenytoin, originally sold as the patent drug Dilantin and now available under other brand names, is an anti-seizure medication. It is useful for the prevention of tonic–clonic seizures (also known as grand mal seizures) and focal seizures, but not absence seizures. The intravenous form, fosphenytoin, is used for status epilepticus that does not improve with benzodiazepines.

pharmacology.text: Phenytoin is believed to protect against seizures by causing voltage-dependent block of voltage gated sodium channels. This blocks sustained high frequency repetitive firing of action potentials. This is accomplished by reducing the amplitude of sodium-dependent action potentials through enhancing steady-state inactivation. Sodium channels exist in three main conformations: the resting state, the open state, and the inactive state.

uses.text: Phenytoin, originally sold as the patent drug Dilantin and now available under other brand names, is an anti-seizure medication. The intravenous form, fosphenytoin, is used for status epilepticus that does not improve with benzodiazepines. It may also be used for certain heart arrhythmias or neuropathic pain.

sideEffects.text: Common side effects include nausea, stomach pain, loss of appetite, poor coordination, increased hair growth, and enlargement of the gums. Potentially serious side effects include sleepiness, self harm, liver problems, bone marrow suppression, low blood pressure, toxic epidermal necrolysis, and atrophy of the cerebellum.

summaryZh: 苯妥英（INN:phenytoin，簡稱PHT），以Dilantin（有大侖丁的譯名）等品牌名稱於市場上銷售，是一種抗癲癇藥。它可用於預防全身強直陣攣發作（也稱為大陣攣發作 ）和傑克遜癲癇（局部發作），但不適用於失神性癲癇。當使用苯二氮平類藥物治療癲癇重積狀態後仍未改善，可改用磷苯妥英（一種苯妥英的靜脈注射形式） 。
summaryZhHans: 苯妥英（INN:phenytoin，简称PHT），以Dilantin（有大仑丁的译名）等品牌名称于市场上销售，是一种抗癫痫药。它可用于预防全身强直阵挛发作（也称为大阵挛发作 ）和杰克逊癫痫（局部发作），但不适用于失神性癫痫。当使用苯二氮䓬类药物治疗癫痫重积状态后仍未改善，可改用磷苯妥英（一种苯妥英的静脉注射形式） 。

fact.en: Phenytoin was made in 1908 but sat unused for thirty years until Houston Merritt and Tracy Putnam tested it on cats in 1936 and found it stopped seizures without making the animals sleepy.
fact.zh: 苯妥英在 1908 年就已合成，卻被閒置三十年，直到 1936 年休斯頓．梅里特與特雷西．普特南在貓身上測試，發現它能止住癲癇發作而不使動物昏睡。
fact.zhHans: 苯妥英在 1908 年就已合成，却被闲置三十年，直到 1936 年休斯顿．梅里特与特雷西．普特南在猫身上测试，发现它能止住癫痫发作而不使动物昏睡。
